_comment: DRAFT, NOT SUBMITTED. Mode orderavg_d13_v3w: TEST-TIME ORDER AVERAGING screen of D13 (job-hjwpq art-cr9a2 BEST step 1600, joint_record head) on the pre-declared proxy600 rows (644) under the v3w readout, UNTEMPERED as the 41.07 screen scored it. Three arms in ONE job from the same forward passes (jobs/m2_first_cell/orderavg.py; decide.debias.OrderAveragedBackend): N=1 = the plain v3w prompt (control; must reproduce 41.07 [37.57, 45.22] within noise), N=2 = + reversed option order, N=4 = + two seeded cyclic shifts; every choice question's per-option probabilities averaged over its distinct orders (noul / score never reordered). Pre-registered rule: jobs/m2_first_cell/ORDERAVG_README.md. Rate: the screen's measured child wall 1,669.2 s / 644 rows = 1.2513 s per 1k v3w tokens (1,481,526 v1 tokens x 0.9004); the N=4 arm reads each row once per pass = 2.844 x the tokens (order_avg_token_ratio, CPU-computed: 1,949 passes over 644 rows, k=2 questions need 2): 79.1 min + 40 fixed (load + 150k lineage ~30, plan pass over every pass ~7) = 119 min (cap 138). Hold: max_duration 190 min x $0.063 = $11.97 quoted. No subsampling (all 644 proxy600 rows; the 322-row half was not needed).
